title: Scoping research (next week): is anything on Hyperliquid or trade[XYZ] (Hyperliquid builder-deployed perps, e.g. XYZ100) worth trading for us?
note: OPERATOR ASK 2026-10-27 ~12:00Z (manager session session_01AFoLuJi1vLTnYv9LbP6539), verbatim: "I also want to queue up a research session for next week, like a sort of general scoping research task to see if there's anything on Hyperliquid or trading XYZ that would be worth trading." TIMING: after the weekly reset (Wed 2026-10-28 ~18Z); schedule at Thursday planning. ONE question: is there an instrument/venue there worth a Stage-0 question? Scope (desk research + public data only, no account, no keys, no orders): (1) what trades there: Hyperliquid perps/spot universe and trade[XYZ] HIP-3 markets (equity indices/single stocks, e.g. XYZ100 also seen on tradeify_1 since 2026-10-15); (2) cost stack per symbol: maker/taker fees, measured spread/depth from public book data, funding regime, oracle/mark design; (3) where it adds to what we already trade (new instruments, 24/7 equity exposure, cheaper cost than Bybit on overlapping symbols, funding-carry edges), and where it is redundant; (4) access mechanics: wallet-based auth, API/WebSocket, data history available for a backtest, regulatory/jurisdiction notes for the operator; (5) a ranked shortlist with, per candidate, the Stage-0 research/queue unit it would become (pre-registered rule, harness, cost stack) — or 'nothing worth it' with the reason. OUTPUT: one memo-free result: pre-registered queue units for the kept candidates (roadmap L-LADDER: a new venue enters through a Stage-0 question) + a one-page summary in the PR. Model Sonnet, ceiling ~$6. ADDED 2026-10-27 ~12:05Z, operator verbatim: "And if it would be worth building the infra". So the lane also answers (6) BUILD COST vs VALUE: what wiring a new venue takes here (new-broker skill checklist: package + factory + integrator + executor, accounts.yaml entry, data ingest + candle/funding history, wallet-key custody on the VM, monitoring/reconciliation, demo/testnet floor for Stage 1), sized in lane-days and ongoing maintenance, against the expected value of the kept candidates (edge net of the full cost stack x capacity, or the cost saving vs Bybit on overlapping symbols). Verdict per candidate: build / wait for Stage-0 evidence first / not worth it, with the reason. Default stance: Stage-0 evidence before any infra build. 2026-11-10 10:15Z manager: the row had sat queued since 2026-11-02 with no due_by, so it never came due. Operator re-asked ('did we add the post-reset research item for hyperfluid/xyz?'). Set due_by 2026-11-13, post-reset, alongside TRADEIFY-FUTURES-EVAL and PROP-PLAN-EV-6M. Related evidence: the RQ-20261015-24ca-* units (done) priced QQQ/SPY legs as XYZ100/SP500 CFDs for Tradeify. Reuse them; don't re-run.
